+    Scale the brightness of the palette of a "P" image, in place.
+
+    Every color channel of every palette entry is multiplied by
+    ``lightness_factor`` and clamped to 0-255. The alpha channel of an RGBA
+    palette is left alone. Only the palette changes: the pixels keep their
+    indexes, so no color is added and nothing is quantized again.
+    """
+    from . import ImagePalette
+
+    table = bytearray(256)
+    for value in range(1, 256):
+        scaled_value = value * lightness_factor
+        table[value] = 255 if scaled_value >= 255 else int(scaled_value)
+
+    def scale(data, channels):
+        data = bytes(data)
+        scaled = bytearray(data.translate(table))
+        if channels == 4:
+            scaled[3::4] = data[3::4]
+        return bytes(scaled)
+
+    mode = im.im.getpalettemode()
+    scaled = scale(im.im.getpalette(mode, mode), len(mode))
+    if mode == "RGBA":

+        for channel in range(3):
+            rgb[channel::3] = scaled[channel::4]
+        im.im.putpalette("RGB", bytes(rgb))
+        im.im.putpalettealphas(scaled[3::4])
+    else:
+        im.im.putpalette("RGB", scaled)
+
+    palette = im.palette
+    if palette is not None and palette.rawmode is None:
+        palette.palette = scale(palette.tobytes(), len(palette.mode))
+    else:

+
